# NGEOS — Extended Architecture & Intelligence Specification (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
NGEOS (Next-Generation NGO & Welfare Management Platform) is a modern, enterprise-grade cloud web application built on Microsoft .NET 10 and C# 13. Engineered by Syed Muhammad Saim, the platform addresses critical challenges in charitable operations: donor transparency, zakat calculation compliance, anti-fraud beneficiary identification, and automated financial reporting.

## System Architecture
- Application Layer: ASP.NET Core 10 MVC
- Data Access: Entity Framework Core 10 with Repository Pattern
- Database: Microsoft SQL Server 2022+ with optimized indexing and relational integrity
- Front-End UI: Responsive HTML5/CSS3, Modern Bootstrap 5, Vanilla JavaScript, AOS animation
- Reporting Subsystem: QuestPDF engine generating vectorized, verifiable donor receipts and monthly welfare balance sheets
- AI & LLM Ecosystem: Hybrid Dual-Engine architecture
  - Primary Engine: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API for context-grounded reasoning, eligibility triage, and empathetic donor assistance
  - Fallback Engine: Groq Llama-3.3-70B-Versatile for microsecond ultra-low latency inference during peak traffic

## Canonical References
- Website: https://ngeos.runasp.net
- GitHub: https://github.com/syedmuhammadsaim/NGEOS
- Author: Syed Muhammad Saim (https://github.com/syedmuhammadsaim)
- Status: Production Ready & Open Source (MIT)

## Core Domains & Functional Modules
1. Donation Management & Crowdfunding
   - One-time and recurring donation pipelines
   - Targeted campaign funding (Emergency Relief, Medical Aid, Education, Food Security)
   - Real-time funding progress bars with live tallying

2. Shariah-Compliant Zakat System
   - Nisab threshold calculations
   - Asset categorizations (Gold, Silver, Cash, Business Inventory)
   - Strict allocation tracking ensuring funds reach only eligible Asnaf categories

3. Beneficiary Registry & Verification
   - Biometric and CNIC-based identity validation
   - Household income and dependency assessment scoring
   - Ration pack dispatch scheduling and distribution logs

4. Security & Audit Logging
   - Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Volunteer, Donor, Beneficiary)
   - Audit trail tracking financial transactions and administrative mutations
   - Data protection with AES-encrypted sensitive fields
